messages.subject: Verdant v Calderhall HT-2026-000087 - directions for the CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor,

Ahead of the CMC on 8 October, please find our letter on directions attached, with a draft DRD and draft order. In short we propose Model C disclosure of your client's manufacturing, in-process QC and batch-release records and any root-cause investigation; one expert each in cell electrochemistry/failure analysis with sequential reports; and a 5-day TCC trial in Q2 2027. We'd like to agree as much of the order as possible.

We also invite your client's position on whether the reasonableness of clause 11 should be tried as a preliminary issue.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: Verdant v Calderhall HT-2026-000087 - directions for the CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

We agree single experts are not appropriate and accept sequential reports. We resist Model C for the root-cause documents as disproportionate and say Model B suffices; we can discuss at the CMC. We do not agree to a preliminary issue on clause 11 - it is bound up with the facts and should be tried with everything else. Otherwise the draft order is broadly acceptable. We'll mark up and revert.

Eleanor
